title: Rigorous analysis of the time-splitting methods for the semiclassical Dirac equation
summary: We provide rigorous error analysis of the mass-preserving time-splitting methods for solving the semiclassical Dirac equation. The scaled Planck constant $ε$ in the equation gives rise to rapid oscillations in both space and time when $0<ε\ll 1$ with wavelengths of order $O(ε)$. %We prove that the first-order splitting $S_1$ and the second-order splitting $S_2$ schemes preserve the total discretized mass.
